info.name: CodeIntelligence Requirement Impact Validation — Tests 38–50
info.description: Tests 40 and 43 reproduce known exact requirements; Tests 38,39,41,42 are reconstructed scenarios, not recovered original prompts. Tests 44–50 are new edge cases. Requires indexed Java project and running FastAPI.

pm.test('Clarification required', function () { const r=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED'); pm.expect(r.clarification_required || (r.requirement_intent && r.requirement_intent.clarification_required)).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('Conflicting values CA and FR identified', function () { const r=pm.response.json(); const cs=r.requirement_conflicts || (r.requirement_intent && r.requirement_intent.instruction_conflicts) || []; const s=JSON.stringify(cs); pm.expect(s).to.include('CA'); pm.expect(s).to.include('FR'); });
